selection_basis: Flash/ignition is a zero-coverage target, but Wave 1 already contains several exact flash-point recall questions under Properties. B15 therefore focuses on source-specific autoignition temperature, explosion range, within/outside-range decisions and ignition-property interpretation without recreating those flash-point propositions.

pinpoint_scope: Each registered MHLW model SDS Section 9 physical/chemical properties: autoignition temperature, explosion range, and other explicitly present ignition-relevant fields
source_contract.locator_rule: Every candidate must bind to one registered SDS source/version and a single Section 9 field. No answer-defining cross-chemical comparison is allowed without a source-bundle contract.

planned_families: single-substance autoignition-temperature recall where not already canonical
within-versus-outside explosion-range decisions using one SDS
ordering of lower/upper bounds within the same SDS
flash point versus autoignition concept distinction only where the single SDS supplies both values and the question does not duplicate existing exact flash-point recall
vapor/ignition hazard interpretation where directly supported by one Section 9 record
anti_duplication_rule: Do not recreate exact flash-point recall for gasoline, kerosene, acetone, ethanol, methanol, toluene, benzene, xylene or ethyl acetate already represented in the canonical bank.
